title: ConfigErrors
description: Written to standard error, with exit status 2, when the workspace can't be loaded in JSON mode (COM-071).

field.description: The setting at fault (linux, overlay, ..., or an unknown key), or the resource: config.toml (not TOML), compat-index, validation.json, dt-schema, tools, deploy.

hints.description: What to do about the errors, each once.
